name: Chippy Candy Co
notes: Own site (Chippy Candy Company – LAVA CRUNCH) gives Honolulu, Hawaii and shows the handle @contactchippycandy, but does not name the platform, so Instagram is left null. Site has a 'buy' button for peanut and macadamia brittle but I did not get a checkout URL. Site is undated, so still_active is unknown. No market schedule found. Seed says Windward, but the site only says Honolulu.

name: Da Manju Lady
notes: Marketspread vendor profile (Honolulu County, HI 96816) says it bakes traditional manju and mentions an Instagram contact, but does not show the handle. Also listed in the Windward Mall market vendor list at https://plentyofaloha.com/ (undated). Past Mililani Town event listings also name Da Manju Lady. No own accounts confirmed, so all handles are null.

name: Da Poi Boi
notes: Handle @dapoiboi808 is credited to Toshio Toguchi, who started the brand, in a recent Aloha Girl article. A Sept 2026 Mountain View Voice article confirms Toshio Toguchi runs the Oahu-based Da Poi Boi (he was doing a poi-making demo there), so it is active. Aloha Girl says he sells at farmers markets and events. Da Poi Boi is also on the Windward Mall market vendor list at https://plentyofaloha.com/. No dated market schedule found.

name: Datz Fiyah!
notes: Honolulu Festival 2025 vendor page: mother and daughter run it, established 2024, sells li hing mui gummies, lollipops and baked goods. Also listed as 'Datz Fiyah Candy Shop' at the Apr 11, 2026 Mililani High School Athletics Foundation craft fair (Eventeny), and at island craft fairs including the Koolau Night Market (https://www.islandcraftfairs.org/events/ws2ej). No own Instagram, Facebook or website found. Do not confuse with 'Datz Sew Fiyah' (clothing) or Island Fiyah Grill. Seed has no region.

name: Dip Into Paradise
notes: Kaneohe-based (45-537 Paleka Rd) snack and food distributor. Own site has an online store with holiday gift packs, and its About page says 'Find us at an Oahu event' (events page exists but I did not get its URL). The Instagram handle @dipintoparadise comes from a Pop-Up Mākeke vendor page that says it is the business's Instagram. The Facebook page posts Windward Mall Farmers Market reminders (undated). Also on the Windward Mall vendor list at plentyofaloha.com.

name: Elsie's Toffee
notes: No source found for this exact business. Search only returned Elsie's Smoothie Shack (Laie, a different business) and Toffee O! (different owner), so I did not use them.

name: Georgi's Goodies
notes: Kaneohe home bakery (banana bread, bundt cakes) owned by Georgi DeCosta. Its Facebook page intro lists 'georgis_goodies', georgisgoodies.square.site and linktr.ee/georgis.goodies. I took georgis_goodies as the Instagram handle, but the intro does not label the platform. A KHON2 piece from about 115 days ago says it is at Windward Mall Farmers Market every Sunday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., and takes online orders at georgisgoodies.com. Also on the plentyofaloha.com Windward Mall vendor list. A Nextdoor page mentions Saturday weekend inventory in Kaneohe (not verified).

name: Green Times Matcha
notes: Handle @greentimes.matcha is given in several Star-Advertiser and Aloha State Daily articles (Oct 2025 to Aug 2026). Star-Advertiser says its monthly pop-up schedule is posted on Instagram. Weekly stop: Thursdays 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at fishcake, 307 Kamani St, Kakaako (Apr and Aug 2026 articles). Also pops up at night markets and was at the Made in Hawaiʻi Festival (Aug 2026 article) and a Sept 2026 West Oʻahu matcha festival. Owner is Jinie Ho. No website or Facebook found. The handle was not checked on Instagram directly.

name: HB Baking
notes: Brand is 'Slice by HB Baking' (ice cream pies and cakes). The own site names Instagram @slicebyhbbaking and lists a second account, slicecreamtruck, with no platform, so I left it out. At last crawl (about 130 days ago) the site said the shop was temporarily closed for a move but the kitchen took custom orders by phone, (808) 202-8601, or Instagram DM, and the truck can be booked for events. Current status is unclear, so still_active is null. The address on the site is 1016 Kapahulu Ave, Honolulu, which is not Central as the seed says. Marketspread also has a vendor profile (https://marketspread.com/vendor/51698/hb-baking-inc/). No public market schedule found.

name: Haitai Hawaii
notes: Not a food vendor: a women-owned maker of handmade obi bags and Okinawan-print goods, run by Eriko Paquin. Etsy and Eventeny list it in Mililani, not Town/Honolulu. Active events: Mililani High School Athletics Foundation Mother's Day fair (Apr 11, 2026), Winter Craft Fair in Waipahu (Nov 29, 2025), Honolulu Festival 2026 (30th). The Facebook page promotes a Craft & Collectibles Fair at the Japanese Cultural Center of Hawaii on Sept 12 (year not shown). Pinterest says to DM Instagram to purchase. No standalone website found.

name: Harrison's Mustard
notes: Own site 'MUSTARDMAN808' sells Harrison's Mustard and says it also ships. It lists Windward Mall Center Court (46-056 Kamehameha Hwy, Kaneohe) every Sunday 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. and some Wednesdays 2 to 6 p.m. It also lists Kaiser High School Market on Tuesdays and Koko Marina Shopping Center on Aug 15, 2026. The posted dates were for July and August 2026, so the schedule may be out of date. Phone (808) 222-6043. No Instagram or Facebook handles found. Also on the plentyofaloha.com Windward Mall vendor list.
